plainText:
Jason Adam Griffith is an American actor and voice actor for the English-language dub of . He is sometimes credited as J. Griff or Adam Caroleson.

==Biography==
Griffith was born on November 29, 1980, in Lakeline, Ohio, and became a voice actor as an adult. He began to provide voices for Pokémon during . His initial tenure with the series ended after the eighth season, when 4Kids Entertainment gave up the dubbing and distribution of the series to and TAJ Productions. He later returned in Cream of the Croagunk Crop!. In , Griffith gained his most significant role, providing the voice of . Griffith is currently affiliated with Innovative Artists.

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
Griffith was best known for voicing Sonic the Hedgehog in Sonic X and every Sonic game from to , replacing , Sonic's previous voice actor, and being replaced by . He also did the voice of two of Sonic's rivals: and .

==Trivia==
Griffith has voiced two Gym Leaders who happen to share their Gym Leader status with their siblings: Cilan and Tate. Cilan and Tate are also both the result of a , with Cilan being a triplet with Chili and Cress and Tate being the twin brother of Liza.
Griffith is the first returning former 4Kids voice actor who has gained a role of a main character during the TPCi dub. The second is Rebecca Soler.
